title: Justify
description: A lyric set as a force-justified block in soft black Arial on white. Drag the right edge and the words flow like one ribbon: each slides along its line, rolls around the margin and comes back in at the start of the next, never crossing another word; rewrite it or switch lyrics and the shared words travel to their new places.
intent: Force-justification as a live material with reflow that is physically continuous: the measure is a roller the text winds around, so every word keeps one body and one path, interruptible mid-drag.
sources: herb reference board: 0fc59ca9 (I'm a star justified block) and ee6eda60 (the sun'll come out, blurred justified block)
